# Deck Design — DataArt Corporate

Turn a plain-language brief into a finished, on-brand DataArt presentation —
composed as real HTML slides on the Corporate Slides Kit and exported to a
fully editable PowerPoint file.

**Version:** 1.0.0 · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Description

The skill takes a deck brief (a chat message or an AIMS64 handoff envelope),
plans the narrative arc, and assembles every slide from the DataArt Corporate
Slides Kit — a pixel-faithful, Figma-derived design system (1920×1080, Arial:
design tokens, layout CSS, 39 slide templates, SVG icon and logo libraries).
The kit is the single source of visual truth: no external UI frameworks, no
invented styles. The result is a set of verified HTML slides plus a branded
`.pptx` where text stays editable and the DataArt slide master with reusable
layouts is built in.

## What it can do

- **Build decks in the DataArt Corporate style** — covers, section dividers,
  content grids, process flows, timelines, comparisons, team and contact
  slides, use-as-is corporate slides (fast facts, capabilities, partnerships).
- **Design the narrative, not just the slides** — maps a brief onto a proven
  story arc (context → problem → approach → showcase → plan → team → next
  steps) with copy-budget and layout-variety checks.
- **Export production PPTX** — native editable text runs (no rasterised
  copy), the official DataArt slide master (44 pt title, 9-level body ramp,
  white logo on dark) and 15 reusable layouts in PowerPoint's Layout menu.
- **Verify what it ships** — headless render of the whole deck with
  composition gates: overflow, cramped copy, safe zones, banned typography.
- **Iterate** — accepts feedback rounds and AIMS64 iteration context while
  preserving the approved structure.
